**Updated Understanding:**
Coal-powered plants are intended to convert the chemical energy stored in coal into kinetic energy. The process involves burning coal to release heat (chemical energy → thermal energy), generating steam to drive turbines (thermal energy → kinetic energy), and using generators to produce electricity (kinetic energy → electrical energy). The overall design goal is to deliver kinetic energy to the grid.
